title: dev.hugr.corelink.dsr.erasure.verification_failed.v1
description: 24h verification cron sweep detected at least one non-successful backend outcome OR the SLA window (24h) elapsed with unverified backends. Audit fires BEFORE the SEV-1 alert + RB-DSR-ERASURE-INCOMPLETE runbook activation per FM-450 P0 S=5 → upgrade FF-HR-010.

decision.description: Canonical 4-arm failure decision (mirrors ErasureDecision::{VerifiedPartial, SlaBreached, VerificationFailed, Rejected}).

failed_count.description: Number of canonical backends that reported a non-successful outcome (0-12).

elapsed_ms.description: Time elapsed since plan generation (Unix epoch ms delta). > 24h × 3_600_000 indicates SLA breach.

error_classes.description: Canonical error class mnemonics (e.g. evidence_settle_delay, neon_timeout, stripe_rate_limit) for forensic re-correlation.
